_comment: Third-party dataset artifacts from AxBench (Wu et al., 2025; arXiv:2501.17148), hosted at hf.co/datasets/pyvene/axbench-concept500 (CC-BY-4.0). Fetched by scripts/fetch_axbench.py; NOT committed (see README.md). Concept500 stores labelled positive (concept-present) / negative (unsteered) instruction+response pairs per concept — the contrast DiffMean is built from. Byte sizes are the HF tree API values at the pinned commit; the fetcher verifies them.
_variant_note: AxBench stored one copy of Concept500 per (extraction model, layer) it released dictionaries for: 2b/l10, 2b/l20 (gemma-2-2b-it) and 9b/l20, 9b/l31 (gemma-2-9b-it). We extract on OUR model, so the model/layer folder only selects which released copy of the labelled text to read; default is 2b/l20.
